decision: Frozen criterion not met: label agreement 99/117 vs 95/117, but including map generation requests only decrease 2.15%, below the required 5%.
limitations: Previously seen development set, not an independent holdout. Labels are not finding-level semantic support judgments.
One generated map per variant; no map-generation variance estimate. Three repeats per question are correlated.
24 map-arm investigations had no usable map. They still used 23 fewer requests than matched baseline runs, indicating sampling/provider variance.
Map arm changed 11 baseline misses to matches and 7 baseline matches to misses; small net improvement is not proof of general accuracy gain.
No semantic verifier in this comparison; production audits still verify findings.
Empty maps are not cached in production, so repeated future audit failures may pay generation again.
next_step: Keep repository memory opt-in; continue with persisted events and SSE progress rather than tune on these same cases.
